scope: Unmodified public craft_xwing, loaded through the real Worker and started with the native trial button. Real star-map selection and jump command from rest. All velocity, position, burst clocks and preparation state are generated by production RAF; the harness only observes them.

conditions.cache: Task-specific persistent Chromium profile; normal IndexedDB cache is retained. No cold-start or performance claim.
conditions.safari: Real Safari and iPhone/iPad not tested
conditions.simulation: No timer, velocity, readiness, power or heat injection. Native pause is used only to capture actual states.
